description: Design and Implementation of Digital Twin Models for Continuous Monitoring and Performance Prediction of Precast Concrete Bridges [supporting dataset] is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Volodymyr Kindratenko, Bassem Andrawes. National Transportation Library (NTL) Curation Note: This dataset has been curated to CoreTrustSeal's curation level "A. Active Preservation". To find out more information on CoreTrustSeal's curation levels, please consult their "Curation & Preservation Levels" CoreTrustSeal Discussion Paper" (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11476980). NTL staff last accessed this dataset at its repository URL on 2025-03-19. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-PDDC. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
